title: Microshape Advisor and QuantBank: tenant microbatch guidance and safe quant rollouts
author: Marta Chen
release_notes: Adds a Microshape Advisor service to recommend tenant-specific microbatch shapes and a QuantBank service to store vetted quantization profiles with safe rollout metadata; behind feature flag; no breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: many tenants have bursty, shape-varying request patterns that are poorly served by single static minibatch configurations. This PR introduces two coordinated components: (1) Microshape Advisor, a runtime service that observes per-tenant sequence-length and concurrency distributions and recommends microbatch shapes (microbatch size, stride, KV split hints) optimized for latency/cost tradeoffs; (2) QuantBank, a small internal registry of validated quantization profiles annotated with compatibility fingerprints and safe-rollout constraints. Together they enable automated, tenant-aware recommendations and staged quant rollouts with guardrails. Summary of changes: added runtime Microshape Advisor + agent shim, QuantBank API and CLI, controller logic to join Advisor recommendations with existing autoscaling rules, recommendation serializer for the Console, a lightweight simulation harness for unit-econ impact estimation, docs and migration notes, and tests. Rollout plan: feature gated behind experimental.microshape and experimental.quantbank; start as read-only recommendations in console for selected tenants, then enable automated suggestions (opt-in) and finally enable auto-apply for low-risk profiles after 2 weeks of telemetry. Backwards compatibility: all public endpoints are additive and default to current behavior when the flags are off. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-4321) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Simulation harness & example tenant profile - [x] Docs & Console wiring - [x] Feature flags - [x] Safety gates for quant rollouts Safety and testing: QuantBank entries require a signed compatibility fingerprint (model architecture, tokenizer hash, quant backend) and a staged rollout plan (canary percent, min-successful-requests). The Microshape Advisor runs with a conservative default that never raises microbatch size above tenant-configured max. Telemetry: new metrics microshape.recommendation.count, quantbank.rollout.progress, sim.unit_econ.delta; tracing spans for advisor decision points. Known limitations: advisor currently uses a sampling window of 10k requests and may be slow to converge for very small tenants; simulation assumes stationary arrival distributions. Future work: extend advisor to recommend KV caching windows and to feed batched kernel selection for FPGA/TPU profiles. Please see the Design doc link in Linear for simulation details.
commits: Initial Microshape Advisor service and agent shim
Add QuantBank service, CLI and API wiring
Controller: integrate recommendations with autoscaler rules
Simulation harness for unit-econ estimation and test cases
review_comments: Arjun: The advisor looks great—two asks: add a bounded memory cap for the sliding window and add an explicit TTL for sampled examples so the advisor can forget stale patterns (reply: added both, see microshape_advisor.py sampling config; memory cap defaults to 50MB and TTL is configurable).
Lena: QuantBank API needs stronger validation on the compatibility fingerprint format and clearer error codes (reply: tightened validation, added 400/409 responses and tests).
Diego: suggest an e2e smoke that runs a short simulation and asserts unit-econ delta doesn't regress by >1% (reply: added sim/unit_econ and integrated into CI smoke suite).
Arjun: please add an audit log entry when an auto-apply of a quant profile occurs (reply: added telemetry event quantbank.auto_apply and wired to audit log).
Lena: docs — add explicit opt-out instructions and CLI steps to revoke a rollout (reply: docs updated with CLI examples).
merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals and green CI. Feature flags enabled false by default; console now surfaces recommendations for internal tenants. Tests and docs included.
post_merge_actions: Enable internal canary for 5 tenants via feature flag toggle (ops runbook)
Schedule 72h telemetry review to confirm unit-econ impact
notes_for_release_manager: This is behind experimental flags; add migration note to Ops doc and do not enable auto-apply by default. Coordinate with SRE before enabling for production tenants.
risk_assessment: Medium: changes touch runtime decision paths and introduce an auto-apply flow for quant profiles. Safety mitigations include feature flags, canary percent, telemetry thresholds, and explicit audit events.
qa_instructions: 1) Toggle experimental.microshape=on for internal-a tenants; 2) Feed synthetic bursty traffic using scripts/qa/run_sim.sh; 3) Verify microshape.recommendation.count increments and Console shows recommendations; 4) Create a QuantBank profile via CLI, then run a staged rollout and confirm quantbank.rollout.progress telemetry and audit logs.
changelog_entry: 2026-03-05: Introduced Microshape Advisor and QuantBank (experimental flags). Recommendations only by default; opt-in staged rollouts for quant profiles.
